sanskrit:
एतान्न हन्तुमिच्छामि घ्नतोऽपि मधुसूदन ।
अपि त्रैलोक्यराज्यस्य हेतोः किं नु महीकृते ॥ १-३५॥
iast:
etānna hantumicchāmi ghnato’pi madhusūdana
api trailokyarājyasya hetoḥ kiṃ nu mahīkṛte 1-35
translation: These I do not wish to kill, though they kill me, O Madhusudana, even for the sake of dominion over the three worlds; how much less for the sake of the earth.
